# Founding full-stack growth Engineer

## About the role

You'll own Clara's growth engine, supporting our mission by helping more patients discover Clara and turn to it for their day-to-day primary care needs. Landing pages, onboarding funnel, experimentation, attribution, and lifecycle messaging all belong to you. You'll work across the entire funnel - from the first ad impression or search result, through signup and onboarding, into first chat, subscription and long-term retention. You'll write the code, ship the pages, wire the events, run the tests, and read the results yourself. You'll partner closely with our clinical and compliance teams to make sure every page, claim and experiment is medically accurate and HIPAA-safe.

### Your responsibilities

Acquisition and conversion surfaces:

- Ship programmatic and SEO-driven page systems for condition, medication and geo intent

- Integrate paid ad platforms with our attribution stack so every channel's true contribution is measurable

- Build and iterate high-velocity landing pages and funnels in React + TypeScript

- Own patient acquisition and onboarding end to end

Product-led growth:

- Build in-product growth loops — activation nudges, referrals, sharing and re-engagement surfaces

- Design onboarding that gets patients to first real value fast, then to habitual use

- Design, build and launch experiments and MVPs autonomously — from hypothesis to shipped test to readout, without waiting to be told what to try

- Turn patient behavior signals into personalized in-product prompts, with clinical review in the loop

Experimentation and attribution:

- Own the experimentation platform end to end — assignment, exposure, guardrails, readouts

- Instrument the funnel in Amplitude and keep the event taxonomy trustworthy

Lifecycle:

- Partner with the clinical team to keep patients engaged with Clara over the long term and realize better health outcomes

- Build event-triggered lifecycle journeys across onboarding rescue, reactivation and re-engagement

- Own the CRM surfaces — email, SMS and in-product notifications — and the logic that decides who hears what, when

### What we're looking for

Required :

- 3+ years software engineering, including 12+ months in a dedicated growth engineering role

- Strong full-stack ability — React + TypeScript front end, Python or TypeScript services

- Experience with product analytics instrumentation (Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar) and event taxonomy design

- Experience scoping and prioritizing initiatives using RICE or a similar framework, and defending the call

Nice to haves:

- Medical domain knowledge or healthcare AI experience

- Comfortable using LLMs as a production tool for content, creative and internal tooling

### What Clara offers founding engineers

Impact:

- Ship code that affects real patient health outcomes

- Make architectural decisions for an AI-first medical practice

- Work directly with founders on technical strategy

Team & culture:

- High-performance founding team at the forefront of healthcare AI

- In-person collaboration in San Francisco (5 days/week)

- Talk to real patients and providers regularly

- No bureaucracy, ship fast

Technology stack

Growth stack: Amplitude (incl. session replay + Experiment), Customer.io , Stripe, Google/Meta/Reddit Ads APIs. Underneath: React 19 + TypeScript product app, Next.js + Payload CMS marketing site on Vercel, Python/Django backend on AWS, and frontier LLMs with proprietary prompts and tool calls.

Visa sponsorship

We will sponsor TN, OPT and H1B transfer work permits for the right candidate.

## About the interview

- Intro call (30 min) - Meet founding team, learn about Clara's mission

- Technical screen (60 min) - Domain-specific challenge

- Onsite (4 hours) - System design, code pairing, team fit

- Reference checks + offer

## About Clara

Clara is an AI-powered medical practice on a bold mission: to add one billion years of healthspan to humanity. We are building the autonomous medical practice of the future, supervised by human medical providers who review and approve every medical decision. Our founders have built and scaled Circle Medical to over $100M in annual revenue, and founding executives have held key roles at Hims and Hers, GoodRx and Teladoc. We are full time in San Francisco and have raised $12M in pre-seed funding from Y Combinator and top investors. This is the A team, and we have a place for you.

# Senior Product Engineer ($220k-$300k + Equity) - NYC

## About the role

# Hey! We're Conveo.ai

Conveo is a YC-backed company in an active growth period. We started this year as a team of ~20 and are on track to reach ~120 by year end. The people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how this company is built.

The engineering team is small and deliberately so. There are no product managers, no designer handoffs, no tickets waiting for someone else to prioritise. Engineers own the full distance from customer problem to working software, and that proximity to the product is exactly what makes this role interesting. You'll report directly to Maarten, our CTO.

We care deeply about what we build and we genuinely enjoy building it together. ☺️

Dig deeper into our Engineering/Product ways of working 👉 here 👈

### What we're building and why

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

## What you'll do

We need a Senior Product Engineer who works backwards from the experience. This is someone who starts with the user's problem, not a spec, and owns everything between that conversation and the code that ships. You shape what gets built, actively contributing to product direction, influencing what we build and how we build it, with real technical and strategic impact.

Own the full stack, from the interface to the infrastructure

Build the interface customers open every day and can't imagine working without. React is the core of what customers see and touch — you lead frontend architecture in React and TypeScript, set the quality bar for components, state management, and performance. And you don't stop there. From API design to cloud infrastructure (AWS), you ship complete, polished features end to end, including AI-powered ones built on LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and async pipelines.

Be the engineering voice in every customer conversation

When a customer has a need, an engineer hears it, interprets it, and solves it. You join customer calls (about once a week), form a clear point of view on what to build, translate feedback into scoped product decisions, and follow through.

Use AI throughout

You reach for agentic solutions first. You use AI to reason, build, review, and test at every stage and you help raise the bar for how the whole team works. Documentation overhead doesn't slow us down here — AI handles that layer, and you're someone who is happy to work that way. You stay current on what frontier models can do and bring that into what we ship.

## What you'll bring

- 6+ years of experience building full-stack applications with TypeScript and Node.js.

- Strong backend experience: designing APIs, working with PostgreSQL, and managing background jobs and async workflows.

- Solid frontend skills with React. .

- Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP) — you're comfortable with services like S3, media pipelines, and deployment tooling.

- Experience building AI-driven applications (e.g. prompt engineering, working with LLM APIs, and/or fine-tuning experience are a plus).

- Can independently lead projects from concept to launch.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with a keen eye for detail.

- A collaborative mindset, able to work autonomously in a small, fast-paced team.

## Bonus

- Experience with React Router v7 or Remix.

- Experience at a small, fast-moving SaaS company where you’ve been client-facing

- Exposure to market research or qualitative research tooling.

- You've shipped agentic AI systems to production and can speak to failure modes, evaluations, and tool design.

## Why join us?

- Ship alongside engineers who've built and scaled products used by millions.

- Work directly with frontier AI models and push what they can actually do.

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity. We want you to own a real piece of what we're building.

- Offices in London, Antwerp, and New York. We work best together, so we ask for 3 days a week in the NYC office.

- Regular socials: rooftop drinks, team dinners, run clubs, and more.

- Twice-yearly off-sites to places worth travelling to. Austria, Las Vegas, and Portugal. 🥳

- Private health coverage (health, dental, vision)

- 401(k) with 4% company match

- Enhanced employer pension contribution.

- 20 days vacation + US federal holidays

- Refer someone great and earn up to $5,000.

## About Conveo

Founded in 2024 and backed by Y Combinator, Conveo is the leading AI-powered customer insights platform. We help the world's largest companies understand their customers — running hundreds of in-depth video interviews overnight, across any language, at a fraction of the cost and time of traditional research.

Since launch, we've become a trusted partner for Unilever, P&G, Nestlé, Google, Canva, and 400+ enterprise teams globally.

What we're building

Customer insights has been broken for decades — slow, expensive, and impossible to scale. A study that used to take weeks of scheduling, interviewing, and manual analysis now runs overnight. Our AI moderates real conversations the way a trained researcher would: listening actively, probing for depth, and building on each answer. Over 70% of the insights we surface come from AI-driven follow-up questions — depth that no survey has ever achieved.

The result is a platform that doesn't just run studies. It builds a living knowledge layer — so every team in an organization can ask questions about their customers and get answers grounded in real human voices.

The opportunity

The market research industry is $100B. The qualitative slice alone is $30B. And AI is expanding what's possible, not just automating what exists. We're early in a long game.

The team

Our Head of Research, Niels Schillewaert, founded Human8 — a 600-person global insights agency. Our CEO co-founded a $75M ARR startup, Datacamp, as CTO. Our commercial team comes from McKinsey and includes former VPs from Ipsos. We raised a $5.3M seed round in early 2025.

The moment

We entered 2026 as a team of ~20. We're on track to reach 120 people by year end. If you want to join a company at the exact inflection point between early-stage scrappiness and real scale — this is it.
